changelog: capacity warning follows the user's language
The live free-tier capacity warning now starts in English and switches immediately to Spanish only when selected by that user.
Server-provided capacity values are safely escaped, and a regression test prevents fixed Spanish text from returning.
changelog_es: capacity warning respects the selected language
The live free-tier capacity warning now starts in English and switches immediately to Spanish only for users who select it.
Server-provided capacity values are escaped before rendering, and a regression test prevents fixed Spanish text from returning.
